race_context: How the seat is elected: in 2026 every county council race on the state candidate list is a district seat, chosen only by voters in that district; the three at-large seats in most counties are filled together at a different election, when voters may pick up to three candidates {in_list}{ic_36_2_3_3}{bsb_monroe_2020}.

Finding the current officeholder and record: council agendas, minutes and the annual budget and salary ordinances show how members voted on spending, tax rates and pay {ic_36_2_5_11}{hancock_council}.
Checking the county's finances: the Department of Local Government Finance publishes each county's budget order, which certifies the approved budget, tax rate and levy for each fund {dlgf_county}.
Comparing candidates: the Indiana Election Division publishes the official 2026 candidate list, and county election boards post sample ballots {in_list}{in_guide}.
